name: Eufornis Major
description: Eufornis Major, sometimes referred to as simply Eufornis, was a prestigious ecumenopolis planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds. Due to their similar names, Eufornis Major was occasionally confused with Eufornis Minor, a remote Outer Rim colony world. In 5 BBY, Telgordo Travel operated a transport service from Coruscant that stopped at Eufornis Major, as well as Plexis and Hosnian Prime.
